enriched_description: Building with transparent glass or polycarbonate walls and roof for plant cultivation. Frame is aluminum (silver, extruded profiles), steel (painted green or galvanized), or wood (cedar, redwood). Glazing panels are rectangular glass panes or twin-wall polycarbonate sheets, creating grid pattern. Roof is pitched (gable or lean-to) or curved (hoop house). Dimensions vary: small (2x3 m) to commercial (10x50+ m). Interior shows shelving, benches, and plant arrangements. Foundation is concrete, gravel, or ground-mounted. Ventilation: roof vents, side windows, or exhaust fans. Door is full-height with handle. Condensation visible on interior glass surface.

Automotive front grating admitting cooling air to radiator. Construction is horizontal or vertical slats (chrome, black plastic, or painted metal) within rectangular frame. Slats are parallel bars (5-15 mm wide) with uniform spacing, or mesh pattern (honeycomb, diamond). Frame surrounds grille with body-colored or chrome border. Emblem or badge centered on grille surface. Depth is 5-15 cm from bumper face. Surface texture is polished chrome (reflective), matte black, or textured plastic. Mounting points visible at edges. Airflow gaps between slats reveal radiator fins behind.

Retail marketplace with large storefront and display windows. Facade features prominent signage with store name and logo. Interior visible through glass: aisles of shelving stocked with packaged goods, produce section with colorful fruits and vegetables, refrigerated cases along walls. Checkout counters at front with conveyor belts and cash registers. Fluorescent lighting illuminates interior. Shopping carts and baskets near entrance. Floor is tile or polished concrete. Exterior shows parking lot, cart corrals, and automatic sliding doors. Color palette is bright with promotional signage.

Execution device with tall vertical frame (height 3-4 meters) constructed from wooden posts and crossbeam. Two vertical posts (square timber, 15-20 cm) support angled blade channel. Blade is heavy triangular steel (weighted, sharp lower edge) suspended by rope and pulley. Release mechanism (trigger/latch) at top. Basket or trough at base to receive severed head. Wood surface is unfinished or weathered, showing grain and construction joints. Metal components (blade, hardware) are dark iron or steel. Overall structure is imposing, with blade visible in raised position. Proportions: tall narrow frame with horizontal crossbeam.

Decorative hinged hair clip (length 5-15 cm) with spring-loaded mechanism. Body is metal (gold-tone, silver-tone, or colored enamel) with decorative surface (jewels, pearls, filigree, or engraved pattern). Hinged clasp opens to reveal toothed or smooth gripping surface. Shape is barrette (elongated oval), bow, flower, or geometric. Surface finish is polished metal, enameled color, or encrusted with rhinestones/crystals. Spring mechanism is concealed within body. Grip teeth are fine metal ridges on inner surface. Decorative elements face outward when worn.

Aerosol can containing hair-holding preparation. Container is cylindrical metal can (height 20-30 cm, diameter 5-7 cm) with plastic cap. Surface is printed with brand name, product type, and graphics in vibrant colors. Spray nozzle (actuator) on top with fine mist aperture. Cap is dome-shaped or flat, removable. Label shows hold strength indicator (light, medium, firm, extra firm) and ingredients. Can surface is smooth with glossy printed graphics. Bottom shows crimped seam and manufacturing codes. Overall form is standard aerosol cylinder with ergonomic grip.

Military vehicle with front wheels and rear continuous tracks. Front: conventional truck cab with windshield, hood, and steering wheels (two front wheels). Rear: tracked propulsion system with rubber or steel tracks wrapping around road wheels. Body is armored or open cargo bed. Length 5-6 meters, width 2 meters. Color is military olive drab, tan, or camouflage pattern. Tracks show individual track links and road wheel arrangement. Cab features military-style flat fenders and headlight guards. Cargo area has drop-down sides and tailgate. Overall hybrid appearance combines truck front with tank-like rear.

Hand tool with heavy metal head and handle. Head is forged steel (polished or painted) with striking face (flat, circular, 2-4 cm diameter) and claw (curved fork for nail extraction) or ball-peen (rounded opposite face). Handle is wood (hickory, ash) with smooth grain, fiberglass (textured grip), or steel (rubber grip). Length 25-35 cm. Head weight 200-500 grams. Claw curves downward with split fork. Striking face shows slight crown. Handle attaches through eye (hole) in head, secured by wedge. Surface texture: smooth metal head, grippy handle.

Basket container with hinged or removable lid. Construction is wicker (natural rattan, brown, woven pattern), willow (light tan, tight weave), or fabric (canvas, collapsible). Shape is rectangular or oval with vertical sides. Lid is domed or flat, hinged on one side or fully removable. Handles are integrated (woven loops) or attached (leather straps, rope). Interior may have fabric lining (white cotton). Dimensions: 40-60 cm tall, 30-40 cm wide. Woven texture shows over-under pattern with visible reed strands. Color is natural tan, stained brown, or painted white.

Handheld electric hair styling device with motor housing and nozzle. Body is pistol-grip or T-shaped plastic housing (black, white, pink, or metallic). Length 20-25 cm. Nozzle is circular or concentrator attachment (narrow slit). Rear intake grille (circular mesh pattern) reveals fan blades inside. Heat/speed control switches on handle or body. Power cord extends from base (2-3 m). Weight is light (300-500 grams). Surface is smooth plastic with matte or glossy finish. Airflow direction is from rear intake to front nozzle. Cool-shot button may be present.
